blurb: Coterie Winery produces limited release wines from acclaimed vineyards in California. They offer a membership subscription service with periodic wine releases and benefits such as price breaks and shipping. The winery emphasizes hand-crafted, non-interventional winemaking and offers custom wine labeling and crush services.
extraNote: Cancel membership anytime by emailing info@coteriecellars.com · Memberships with payments 30 days past due after release date are automatically canceled · Memberships with wines not picked up within 30 days of release date may be canceled · Wines not picked up after 30 days may be shipped by winery · Terms of winery membership subject to change and communicated via email · Cozy neighborhood near downtown San Jose, in an old warehouse transformed into a winery
